name: damage_target
description: FFX-2 per-target damage orchestrator: the HP, MP and ATB damage classes with every modifier (critical, Berserk, Booster, item masters, species killers, back attack, chain, elements, Shell/Protect/Defense, immunity bytes), the status-phase zeroing, the all-target halving, the Damage 9999 snap and the limit. The RNG function is scripted/served from a seeded policy and logged; the back-attack angle helper is replaced by a stub that returns the angle given in the input; everything else is the game code.

function.signature: void dmg_calc_target(int attackerId, Chr *attacker, int targetId, Chr *target, int allFlag, int amount, int cmdId, CmdRow *cmd, Result *result, int mode)

rngHook.note: pp_rng_next(stream). Damage draws use the attacker mode-0 stream (id + 0x14 for party slots, id + 0xd for monster slots 15..30); status rolls use stream + 0x20; the log holds every draw.

fieldMap.note: Offsets inside the structure named by the key; all Chr fields are written before the call.
fieldMap.charge: ActionRec of the target (Chr+0xE98 + idx*0xCC): +0xA8 remaining, +0xAC max (target.charging = 1)
fieldMap.angle: the float the back-attack angle helper returns (stubbed); beyond +-1.9634954929351807 is a back attack

notes: out.hasteSlowFailed (class hastefail only) is derived from the logged group 2 draw: the Haste/Slow rider did not land.
Cases with out.mask bit 0 / 1 / 0x400 are the result status mask after the status rolls (Death, Petrify, Shatter).
in.charge is null unless the target is charging (target.charging = 1).
